question: What mental condition brings liberation to a person in this very life?
premises: The mind can enter a transcendent state beyond ordinary thought.
Liberation is attributed to one whose mind becomes thus.
This liberation is said to arise here.
inference: One whose mind becomes transcendent attains liberation here.
uncertainties: The fused form bhavantīha may reflect nonstandard number agreement.
plain_english: For one whose mind becomes the transcendent mind, liberation arises here.
